title: SkillEarth: Teaching General-Purpose Agents to Act on Earth via Skill Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.15481v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recently developed remote sensing (RS) agents execute real-world tasks with complex workflows through multi-step tool invocation. These agents, however, typically rely on predefined expertise or parameter updates. They thus require updating expert knowledge or retraining models whenever new tools, tasks, or execution patterns emerge, limiting their continual adaptability in dynamic Earth environments. In this work, we seek to equip general-purpose agents with RS tool-call knowledge that can be automatically extracted from demonstrated trajectories without expert intervention or parameter updates. Specifically, we propose SkillEarth, a self-evolving skill extraction method that externalizes RS tool-call knowledge as reusable, retrievable, and evolvable skill files and refines them through observation-grounded evolution. translated_title: SkillEarth：通过技能进化教会通用智能体在地球上执行任务
translated_abstract: 近期开发的遥感智能体通过多步骤工具调用来执行具有复杂工作流的现实世界任务。然而，这些智能体通常依赖于预定义的专业知识或参数更新。因此，每当出现新的工具、任务或执行模式时，它们都需要更新专家知识或重新训练模型，这限制了它们在动态地球环境中的持续适应能力。在这项工作中，我们旨在为通用智能体配备可从演示轨迹中自动提取的遥感工具调用知识，而无需专家干预或参数更新。具体而言，我们提出了 SkillEarth，这是一种自我进化的技能提取方法，它将遥感工具调用知识外化为可复用、可检索、可进化的技能文件，并通过基于观察的进化对其进行精炼。与现有的依赖基于结果的反思来整体精炼技能的自动技能提取方法不同，……
tldr: SkillEarth 提出了一种自我进化的技能提取方法，无需专家干预或参数更新，即可从演示轨迹中自动提取遥感工具调用知识，并将其外化为可复用、可检索、可进化的技能文件，从而使通用智能体能够持续适应动态地球环境。
en_tdlr: SkillEarth proposes a self-evolving skill extraction method that automatically extracts RS tool-call knowledge from demonstrated trajectories without expert intervention or parameter updates, externalizing it as reusable, retrievable, and evolvable skill files to enable general-purpose agents to continually adapt to dynamic Earth environments.
